Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nikhil - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Meera - 9 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Sunita - 42 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Vikram - 37 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Nikhil stands in the park. Sunita and Vikram stand near him.]

Nikhil: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Nikhil throws the ball to Mother.]

Sunita (surprised): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nikhil plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Sunita (happily): "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Meera, Sunita and Vikram stand near him.]

Sunita: "Vikram, look over here."

[Nikhil puts on his school uniform.]

Nikhil: "And then?"

[Nikhil puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Nikhil (happily): "I'm ready!"

[Meera applies kajal to her eyes.]

Meera: "I'm ready!"

[Meera puts on red lipstick.]

Meera (surprised): "How beautiful!"

[Meera puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Meera: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Sunita and Vikram stand near him.]

Sunita: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil dances to the music.]

Vikram: "That was fun!"

[Nikhil claps his hands.]

Nikhil: "Okay, Dad."

[Nikhil points at the sky.]

Sunita (gently): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nikhil thinks for a moment.]

Nikhil (happily): "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil shouts angrily.]

Nikhil: "Dad, are you okay?"

[Nikhil takes the bag from Mother.]

Nikhil: "One more time!"

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Sunita, Vikram and Meera stand near him.]

Vikram: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil eats his breakfast at the table.]

Nikhil: "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil reads a storybook.]

Sunita (gently): "I'm ready!"

[Nikhil writes in his notebook.]

Sunita: "Well done!"

[Nikhil studies for his exam.]

Nikhil (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nikhil does his homework at the table.]

Nikhil (gently): "Meera, listen!"

[Nikhil flops down on the sofa.]

Nikhil: "That's easy."

[Nikhil opens the door and goes out.]

Sunita: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
